panels.title: Verification time by phase
panels.description: Average time per phase, in pipeline order. The iterations of a test within one benchmark run are averaged first, so every test run counts once. The bar's length is the average total.

targets.rawSql:
-- Average the iterations of each test within a benchmark run first, so every test
-- counts once however often it was repeated.
WITH per_test AS (
  SELECT
    AVG(parse_s)        AS parse_s,
    AVG(macros_s)       AS macros_s,
    AVG(idents_s)       AS idents_s,
    AVG(disambiguate_s) AS disambiguate_s,
    AVG(globals_s)      AS globals_s,
    AVG(typecheck_s)    AS typecheck_s,
    AVG(analyze_s)      AS analyze_s,
    AVG(translate_s)    AS translate_s,
    AVG(verify_s)       AS verify_s
  FROM helium_runs
  GROUP BY run_id, suite, test
)
-- One row; the bar chart needs a string column for the bar and one numeric column per segment.
SELECT
  'all tests'         AS run,
  AVG(parse_s)        AS parse,
  AVG(macros_s)       AS macros,
  AVG(idents_s)       AS idents,
  AVG(disambiguate_s) AS disambiguate,
  AVG(globals_s)      AS globals,
  AVG(typecheck_s)    AS typecheck,
  AVG(analyze_s)      AS analyze,
  AVG(translate_s)    AS translate,
  AVG(verify_s)       AS verify
FROM per_test
